headline: A licensed plumber
lead: Cedar Mill Plumbing is a one-truck shop run by Mike Hollister — 18 years in the trade, 6 years on his own. Drains, water heaters, repipe, leak detection, and 24/7 emergency calls inside the Westside service area. Flat-rate pricing on common service calls, free written estimates on bigger projects, photos at completion. No call center, no high-pressure upsell.
imageCaption: On the truck, on the job, and on time
